title: Pennsylvania passes AI-generated advertising disclosure law
excerpt: Governor Josh Shapiro signed a new law requiring clear labels on political and commercial advertisements created or modified by artificial intelligence.
body_html:
Pennsylvania has established new rules for artificial intelligence in advertising. Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act, which mandates clear disclosures on advertisements that utilize AI.

Under the newly enacted legislation, any ad format—including still images, videos, audio, and text—that is significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence must feature a proper label. The requirement ensures that viewers and listeners are informed when digital content is produced or altered using artificial intelligence technologies.
